data.name: Bhasvan
data.gender_notes: Bhasvan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhasvan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhas' meaning 'to shine' and 'van' meaning 'forest'. This name signifies the radiant and shining sun that illuminates the forest. In Hindu mythology, Bhasvan is the name of the Sun God, Surya, who is considered the giver of life and energy. The name Bhasvan carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhasvan usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
